lastCompletedStory.title: Resolve ask()/askChoice() to a default on readline EOF/close

nextStoryContext: US-001 is done: ask() and askChoice() now resolve to defaults on EOF. The next story (US-002) is the belt-and-suspenders fix: add --merge-mode immediate to the build-release AC4 smoke so needsMerge=false and collectSetupAnswers early-returns without touching readline at all. File to edit: scripts/build-release.sh (~line 115). The flag is already parsed by parseSetupArgs.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Docs confirm: 'close' fires on input stream 'end' (EOF); rl.question() callback does NOT fire on EOF. answered-flag + rl.on('close') pattern matches recommended approach.
